_meta.description: Plan switching with a lagged category: WIN_LAG copies plan from the same customer's previous month-end snapshot (partition by customer, order by date). The lag of a categorical is a categorical on plan's dictionary, so a prev_plan x plan crosstab counts the moves with plan names on both axes (windows-first). Each customer's first snapshot has no previous plan (null) and drops from the row axis.
_meta.name: win_lag_category_flows
